sources.title: R: Pareto and Truncated Pareto Distribution Family Functions
sources.snippet: The upper truncated Pareto distribution has three parameters (called $\alpha$, $U$ and $k$ here) but the family function truncpareto () estimates only $k$. With known lower and upper limits, the ML estimator of $k$ has the usual properties of MLEs.
